description: This is a test class for the CreateSubscription class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.thingsearch.subscription package. It contains unit tests verifying the immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality of CreateSubscription instances.

classes.name: CreateSubscriptionTest
